ovl/zcl_gr_je_post.res: One callable method posts a group journal entry and returns messages to the caller. The caller controls when the data is saved, so a later BAdI can drive the class.

kpmg/zmm_me35k_release.res: Contract release works again and is confirmed working. SAP's own include FM06LFFR_FRG_SET, shared by standard ME35K, ME28 and ME35L, is not edited, and seven known issues are documented.

tools/st05_decode.chal: The ST05 export is an undocumented binary format: an ABAP data cluster with a UTF-16 payload compressed with SAP's LZH, containing a second nested cluster compressed the same way.
tools/st05_decode.ai: Wrote an 86-line Python script that inflates both cluster levels and writes the trace records as TSV, all UTF-16 strings and the raw decompressed cluster. ovl/cnsldtn_grpjrnl_api.chal: The read API is analytical only and the posting API API_CNSLDTNGRPJRNLENTR needs S/4HANA 2022 or later. Only engine classes and the draft-based Fiori service remain, and posting without CL_FINCS_DOCUMENT_REFRESH doubles amounts on re-run.
ovl/cnsldtn_grpjrnl_api.ai: Documented the read API and established from two catalogue passes that no released posting API exists on this release. Recorded the posting-engine classes with signatures, traced the Fiori post action chain and wrote a test data pack for FINCS_JRNLENTR_POST_SRV (14 test cases, 8 data sets, four JSON payloads).
ovl/cnsldtn_grpjrnl_api.man: The consultant checked the backend service catalogue twice in the system and supplied service metadata, SE24 screenshots of the classes and the PROCESS_DRAFT source. The team decided the route on 22/10/26.
ovl/cnsldtn_grpjrnl_api.res: The research led to the posting wrapper ZCL_GR_JE_POST on the Data Monitor engine (22/10/26). It records the re-run rule and the upgrade risk of unreleased classes for sign-off.

ovl/cj88_flq.title: CJ88 settlement reversal: update termination traced to standard Liquidity Calculation
ovl/cj88_flq.req: Reversing a WBS settlement in CJ88 ended with 'Update was canceled' express documents and the reversals did not post.
ovl/cj88_flq.chal: The termination sits in standard SAP: the classic Liquidity Calculation inserts with a placeholder document number, so the second insert hits a duplicate key and the whole update rolls back.
ovl/cj88_flq.ai: Identified the exact crash site and mechanism from the ST22 dump, the SM13 update modules and table rows, and explained why the CJ88 log reported success although nothing posted. Recommended deactivating classic Liquidity Calculation for the company code instead of changing standard code.
ovl/cj88_flq.man: The consultant reproduced the error in the system, supplied the dump, update records and table extracts, and took the recommendation to the FI team.
ovl/cj88_flq.res: Root cause proven in SAP standard, so no custom code was changed. A configuration route and test sequence were handed to Finance.

ovl/fbv0_core_gj_912.title: FBV0 posting error CORE_GJ 912 on venture CP0001: root cause in standard VALID_BTYPE
ovl/fbv0_core_gj_912.objects: VALID_BTYPE (standard function module), GJ_PARTNER_CHECK (standard function module), SAPMF05A (standard program), FBV0 (transaction), T8JV (table)
ovl/fbv0_core_gj_912.req: Posting a parked FBV0 document (employee vendor advance coded to corporate venture CP0001) stopped with CORE_GJ 912 'No partner found for venture CP0001 and vendor 7078087', and the user needed the document to post.
ovl/fbv0_core_gj_912.chal: In standard code, GJ_PARTNER_CHECK returns sy-subrc 0 for the corporate venture, so the FBV0 exemption in VALID_BTYPE does not fire and the operator check meets a blank T8JV-OPERATOR. Buffered JVA tables hide the reads from a plain SQL trace.
ovl/fbv0_core_gj_912.ai: Pinned the branch taken from the ST05 trace, the SE37 sources of VALID_BTYPE and GJ_PARTNER_CHECK and SE16N evidence, and documented the three-step mechanism. Ruled out custom code and vendor master gaps, showed SAP KBA 0828606 does not apply, and wrote a reusable five-step method and an SAP incident recommendation.
ovl/fbv0_core_gj_912.man: The consultant ran the ST05 trace, where-used and source scans in the system, supplied the SE37 sources and SE16N extracts, and handed the case to the functional lead on 08/10/26.
ovl/fbv0_core_gj_912.res: Root cause proven in SAP standard, so no custom code was changed. An SAP note or incident route and an interim functional workaround were handed to the functional lead on 08/10/26.

ovl/zfi_cp_mass_ven_pay.title: ZFI_CP_MASS_VEN_PAY mass vendor payment: payment posted without a cheque
ovl/zfi_cp_mass_ven_pay.req: F&A reported that ZFIAPP posted payment document 1726000164 without consuming a cheque (FCHN: 'No check information was found'). They needed the cause and a payment and cheque step that cannot silently diverge.
ovl/zfi_cp_mass_ven_pay.chal: F-53 and FCH5 are two separate CALL TRANSACTIONs in two LUWs, so the payment is saved before the cheque step. The cheque number is guessed as PCEC-CHECL + 1 without reading PAYR or testing the lot ceiling, and every FCH5 error is ignored.
ovl/zfi_cp_mass_ven_pay.ai: From the 08.08.2026 listing, produced a code analysis naming three silent exits in include ZFI_CP_MAS_VEN_AI001 and a hardcoded fiscal-year variant 'V3' for FCH5. Added SE16, SM35, ST22 and SE51 checks, the immediate functional action (new lot in FCHI, manual cheque assignment in FCH5) and a proposed fix.
ovl/zfi_cp_mass_ven_pay.man: The consultant confirmed the cause in the system on 31/08/26 from PCEC (the lot keyed on the selection screen had CHECL = CHECT) and coordinated with F&A, who reported the issue.
ovl/zfi_cp_mass_ven_pay.res: The root cause is confirmed: an exhausted cheque lot. The proposed fix replaces the silent exits with user messages naming the posted document and checks PAYR and the lot ceiling PCEC-CHECT.

ovl/capex_provisional.title: Provisional Capex / Opex fortnightly punching: FS assessment and design
ovl/capex_provisional.req: Business units punch category-wise cumulative Capex (EWIP, DWIP, CWIP, Other) per project at each fortnight end in SAP. SAP must reject a decrease, pre-fill the prior cumulative and show three colour states, with derived views and an Opex equivalent.
ovl/capex_provisional.chal: The ask is not a report: it needs persistence, pre-fill, validation against stored data, a period freeze and per-cell state, so custom tables are needed. JV code cannot be the project key, and the older release makes RAP/Fiori far costlier.
ovl/capex_provisional.ai: Assessed the FS workbook and mapped the Capex and Opex sheets to one punched input table plus derived values. Proposed a three-layer design (six Z tables, an SE38 program with an editable ALV grid, output reports) and found that the Excel silently clamps a decrease to zero.
ovl/capex_provisional.man: The consultant supplied the FS workbook on 18/11/26 and takes the ten design questions to the FS owner.
ovl/capex_provisional.res: The assessment gives a clear build route: a punching transaction with reports on top, a lock on project and period and checks against decreases. The alternatives considered are recorded with reasons.

ovl/wf_pr_release_ws90900008.title: PR release workflow WS90900008 in error: agent rule AC90900002 returns no agent
ovl/wf_pr_release_ws90900008.req: Workflow 50092307 for PR 2100001615 went into error at node 4 ('Rule AC90900002 ended with an exception', SWP 088), and the PR release workflow has to complete.
ovl/wf_pr_release_ws90900008.chal: The rule returned no agent for this PR and is set to terminate on an empty result. The diagnosis works from two SWI1 screenshots and has to establish what the rule keys on.
ovl/wf_pr_release_ws90900008.ai: Read the two SWI1 screenshots and established that rule AC90900002 returned no agent for the first ParForEach index of node 4 and terminates on an empty result, while everything before it ran. Wrote a four-step diagnosis path (PFAC rule simulation, rule function module, EBAN comparison with a PR that worked) and two pitfalls.
ovl/wf_pr_release_ws90900008.man: The consultant supplied the two SWI1 screenshots on 28/10/26 and takes the diagnosis path forward with the rule's function module and PR data.
ovl/wf_pr_release_ws90900008.res: The fault is localised to the agent rule determination at node 4, with a defined path to the cause. SWPR restarts the workflow after the correction, so a new PR is not needed.

ovl/fagl_settings_restrict_mig.title: FAGL_SETTINGS RESTRICT_MIG (KBA 2891129): migrated data in FAGLL03 and FAGLB03
ovl/fagl_settings_restrict_mig.objects: FAGL_SETTINGS (table), FAGLL03 (standard transaction), FAGLB03 (standard transaction), RFBILA00 (standard report), RFBELJ00 (standard report), ACDOCA (table)
ovl/fagl_settings_restrict_mig.req: After the ECC to S/4 conversion, FAGLL03, FAGLB03, RFBILA00 and RFBELJ show migrated data incorrectly. The functional team forwarded SAP KBA 2891129 and wanted the notes and FAGL_SETTINGS steps reviewed, FAGLL03 first.
ovl/fagl_settings_restrict_mig.chal: The migration wrote extra ACDOCA lines with MIG_SOURCE A, C and R that standard reports select. The remedy is SAP notes plus a FAGL_SETTINGS switch per program, the system has no outbound internet, and Fiori apps and Z reports ignore the switch.
ovl/fagl_settings_restrict_mig.ai: Reviewed the KBA and mapped each program to its note and FAGL_SETTINGS parameter (seven-row table), split the work between ABAP/Basis (SNOTE) and functional (SM30, testing), and explained why SNOTE 2697319 returns 'Cannot be implemented'. Wrote three caveats for the functional team and a DEV test plan.
ovl/fagl_settings_restrict_mig.man: The consultant tried note 2697319 in SNOTE and maintained FAGLL03_RESTRICT_MIG = X in FAGL_SETTINGS in DEV client 500 (23/10/26).
ovl/fagl_settings_restrict_mig.res: The FAGLL03 restriction switch is maintained in DEV (23/10/26) and no Z object is needed. The test plan requires the before and after FAGLL03 difference to equal the sum of the account's A, C and R lines.

ovl/zfi_fbl3n_acdoca_u.title: ZFI_FBL3N_ACDOCA_U: BAdI adding ACDOCA-only journal entry lines to FBL3N
ovl/zfi_fbl3n_acdoca_u.req: Journal entries that exist only in ACDOCA with document status 'U' (no BSEG item) are not displayed in FBL3N. They should be listed together with the normal line items.
ovl/zfi_fbl3n_acdoca_u.chal: FBL3N reads BSIS/BSAS through logical database SDF, so the BAdI reads the selection screen by dynamic ASSIGN, selects leading-ledger ACDOCA lines and maps them to RFPOSXEXT, whose fields differ here. The BAdI also fires for FBL1N and FBL5N.
ovl/zfi_fbl3n_acdoca_u.ai: Wrote the complete CHANGE_ITEMS method body (294-line file) with the SE19 creation steps, field-name table, risks and five test steps. After the first activation it removed CPUDT, DMBTR, WRBTR and SEGMENT and switched to U_BKTXT and U_USNAM, matching RFPOSXEXT on this system.
ovl/zfi_fbl3n_acdoca_u.man: The consultant activated the first version on 19/10/26 and fed back the result, then created the implementation in SE19, activated it and tested.
ovl/zfi_fbl3n_acdoca_u.res: ACDOCA-only lines with status U are appended to FBL3N. A transaction-code guard keeps FBL1N and FBL5N untouched, the company-code authority check applies, and the leading ledger is read from T881 instead of being hardcoded.
